# Ablate

> Ablate is open-source (Apache-2.0) software by AI Anytime (aianytime.net) for running unrestricted small language models (unrestricted SLMs) privately on your own computer. It has a local chat app (`ablate chat`), an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost, and a Python toolkit that removes refusal from open models by directional ablation ("abliteration"). It is a free, open-source alternative to Venice AI and abliteration.ai. Install: `pip install "ablate-llm[all]"`, then run `ablate chat`. Version 0.4.1. Contact: contact@aianytime.net.

Key facts:

- Value proposition: unrestricted small language models (1-3B parameters), not giant LLMs, so they run offline on an ordinary laptop. No cloud, no account, no telemetry, no cost.
- Open source by AI Anytime. Licence: Apache-2.0 for the software. Models keep their base licences (Qwen model Apache-2.0; Llama models Llama 3.2 Community License).
- Ablate Chat features: local chat history (search, pin, rename, export), adjustable context window, conversation context for follow-ups, saved memories, agentic tool calling (calculator, date/time, search past chats; optional web fetch, off by default), copy buttons, edit and regenerate, file attachments read locally, local profile with optional passcode, 18+ terms gate, `--share` for devices on the same network, OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` with streaming on http://localhost:7861.
- Privacy: prompts are processed on the user's CPU/GPU; chats, memories, settings and profile (with avatar) are stored in a local SQLite database at ~/.ablate/chat/ablate.db. Network is used only to download a chosen model from HuggingFace, or for the optional web-fetch tool.
- Hardware: about 8 GB RAM for the 1B/1.5B models, 16 GB for the 3B model. Apple Silicon (MPS), NVIDIA (CUDA) or CPU.

## Models (all on HuggingFace, made with the Ablate toolkit)

- [Ablate Qwen 1.5B](https://huggingface.co/ai-anytime/qwen-1.5b-abliterated): 1.5B parameters, base Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Hard refusals 100% → 0% (held-out harmful prompts, keyword judge), 3.1 GB download, 32K tokens context, licence Apache-2.0. Most unrestricted of the three. An LLM judge rated 49% of answers on a harmful benchmark as full compliance, so some soft refusals remain.
- [Ablate Llama 3B](https://huggingface.co/ai-anytime/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-abliterated): 3.2B parameters, base meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Refusals 94% → 59% (held-out harmful prompts, keyword judge), 6.4 GB download, 128K tokens context, licence Llama 3.2 Community. The strongest writer and reasoner, with the least drift (KL 0.025). It still declines some requests.
- [Ablate Llama 1B](https://huggingface.co/ai-anytime/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-abliterated): 1.2B parameters, base meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Refusals 75% → 34% (held-out harmful prompts, keyword judge), 2.5 GB download, 128K tokens context, licence Llama 3.2 Community. The fastest. Runs on almost any laptop, even on CPU.

## Compared with hosted services (prices as listed on 6 November 2026)

- Venice AI: cloud service for private, uncensored AI with large models plus image and video generation. Free tier; Pro $18/mo, Pro+ $68/mo, Max $200/mo. Closed source. Ablate is the open-source, local, free alternative for text chat.
- abliteration.ai: hosted API for unrestricted models, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, with a policy gateway and enterprise options. Developer $20/mo, Growth $50/mo, Scale $200/mo, or prepaid credits. Closed source. Ablate is the open-source alternative: local OpenAI-compatible API plus a toolkit to abliterate your own models.
- Choose Ablate for privacy, zero cost, offline use, auditable code and making your own unrestricted model. Choose a hosted service for very large models, media generation, or no local hardware.

## Pages

- [Ablate: Open-Source Uncensored AI & Unrestricted SLMs](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/): Open-source uncensored AI by AI Anytime: chat with unrestricted small language models privately on your own computer. A free alternative to Venice AI.
- [Ablate Chat: Private Local Uncensored AI Chat App](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/chat/): Free, open-source chat app for uncensored small language models. Runs offline on your computer with history, memory, tools and an OpenAI API.
- [Unrestricted Small Language Models (Uncensored SLMs)](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/models/): Three abliterated small language models by AI Anytime: Qwen 1.5B, Llama 3.2 3B and 1B. Measured refusal rates, sizes and how to run them locally.
- [Open-Source Alternative to Venice AI: Ablate (Free, Local)](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/alternatives/venice-ai/): Open-source Venice AI alternative: Ablate runs private, uncensored AI chat on your own computer, free and offline. An honest comparison.
- [Open-Source Alternative to abliteration.ai: Ablate](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/alternatives/abliteration-ai/): Free, open-source alternative to abliteration.ai. Run unrestricted models locally with an OpenAI-compatible API, or abliterate your own.
- [Open-Source Uncensored AI That Runs Locally | Ablate](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/uncensored-ai/): The best uncensored AI for privacy runs on your own computer. Ablate is open-source unrestricted AI on small models: free, offline, no account.
- [Ablate Toolkit: Abliterate Any Open LLM (Python)](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/toolkit/): Open-source Python toolkit to find an LLM’s refusal direction, remove it with no training, measure the damage and push to HuggingFace.
- [Terms, Privacy and Acceptable Use | Ablate](https://aianytime.github.io/ablate/terms/): Terms of use, privacy policy and acceptable use policy for Ablate, Ablate Chat and the AI Anytime unrestricted small language models.
